Dear Sir/Madam, 
 
Sub: Disclosure under Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) 
Regulations 2015 - Intimation of Q1FY27 Earnings Call 
 
Pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Part A of Schedule III of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and 
Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we would like to inform that an Earnings Conference 
Call with the Analysts/Investors to discuss the financial performance of the Company on the Un-
audited Financial Results for the quarter ended on June 30, 2026 (Q1FY27) is scheduled to be held 
on Tuesday, August 11, 2026 at 4:00 P.M (IST).  
 
The Earnings conference call (Q1FY27) details are enclosed herewith. The above schedule is subject 
to change due to any exigencies.  
 
We request you to kindly take the aforesaid information on record. 
 
Thanking you. 
 
Yours Truly, 
For Websol Energy System Limited 
 
 
 
 
Sanjana Khaitan 
Executive Director
